title: During run passw-hardening TC DUT may become inaccessible
author: AndriiLozovyi
body:

**Description**
When running `passw_hardening TC` on SONiC image which is older than expiration value that TC is setting (the lowest value for now is 10 days), DUT can become inaccessible. And when trying to ssh to DUT you will be asked to change passwd as it expired, this may have negative effect during regression runs. 
```
You are required to change your password immediately (password expired).
You are required to change your password immediately (password expired).

You are on

 \___ \| | | |  \| | | |
  ___) | |_| | |\  | | |___
 |____/ \___/|_| \_|_|\____|

-- Software for Open Networking in the Cloud --

Unauthorized access and/or use are prohibited.
All access and/or use are subject to monitoring.

Help:    https://sonic-net.github.io/SONiC/

WARNING: Your password has expired.
You must change your password now and login again!
```
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Deploy Sonic image which is 10 days old or more
2. Run` passw_hardening` TC
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
DUT became inaccessible, and requires to change password 

**Describe the results you expected:**
TC passed and DUT is accessible 


**Output of `show version`:**

linkedPullRequests.author: AndriiLozovyi
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: Andrii-Yosafat Lozovyi <andrii-yosafatx.lozovyi@intel.com>

<!--
Please make sure you've read and understood our contributing guidelines;
https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/gh-pages/CONTRIBUTING.md

Please provide following information to help code review process a bit easier:
-->
### Description of PR
<!--
- Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed.
- Please also include relevant motivation and context. Where should reviewer start? background context?
- List any dependencies that are required for this change.
-->

Summary: When running passw_hardening TC on SONiC image which is older than 10 days, DUT can become inaccessible.
This happens after `configuring passw-hardening expiration value of 10 days`, and if you're SONiC image is older than 10 days, you're password will be expired and you wont be able to ssh to DUT until password will be changed.
```
You are required to change your password immediately (password expired).
You are required to change your password immediately (password expired).

You are on
  ____   ___  _   _ _  ____
 / ___| / _ \| \ | (_)/ ___|
 \___ \| | | |  \| | | |
  ___) | |_| | |\  | | |___
 |____/ \___/|_| \_|_|\____|

-- Software for Open Networking in the Cloud --

Unauthorized access and/or use are prohibited.
All access and/or use are subject to monitoring.

Help:    https://sonic-net.github.io/SONiC/

WARNING: Your password has expired.
You must change your password now and login again!
```
This might have negative effect on regression runs. In order to fix this issue, we might check when last time password was changed, and then calculate whether expiration value test case are about to set is exceeding aging time of password.
Fixes #6628
